record.field: Comment a keyword → get the link on WhatsApp
People comment a word (e.g. "INFO") on your post; contacts who opted in to WhatsApp get the link right away. The usual way to reach people who engage with a post.

field.name: steps
field.eval: [['message', 'Hi {first_name}, thanks for your comment! Here is the link: ', ''], ['todo', '', 'Follow up on the comment']]

record.field: Private message → new lead and a to-do
Every private message on your social pages becomes a lead in CRM and a to-do for the owner, so nobody waits for an answer.

field.name: steps
field.eval: [['lead', '', 'From a social private message'], ['todo', '', 'Answer the private message']]

record.field: Registered for the event → WhatsApp thank-you
Thank people on WhatsApp as soon as they register for the campaign's event (contacts with an opt-in only).
Clicked the email → lead for sales
Whoever clicks a link in the campaign's email becomes a lead with a to-do, while the interest is fresh.

field.name: steps
field.eval: [['lead', '', 'Clicked the campaign email'], ['todo', '', 'Call the person who clicked']]
